content:
ria_sales: HarvestRx sent back a security questionnaire. Key asks: Private deployment, preserve client source IP for WAF, single static outbound IP for allowlisting, and whether TLS inspection is feasible. Need a short handoff note + ACL snippet and a POC-level cost delta vs Hosted.

sam_netops: Quick options: VPC peering/transit preserves src IP. PrivateLink does NOT preserve src IP (traffic shows ENI IP). To expose a single egress IP you need NAT/EIP in the transit path.

leo_se: Patterns we recommend:
1) VPC peering or Transit GW -> our Private VPC (preserves srcip).
2) PrivateLink + lightweight proxy in their VPC that forwards X-Forwarded-For (requires trusting headers).
3) Managed egress NAT with static EIP (breaks src IP unless combined with proxy).

eve_infosec: TLS inspection note: If they need transparent MITM, confirm no cert pinning. We support customer-managed KMS for Private and audit log exports (30/90/365 day options). HSM available on request.

ria_sales: ACL snippet to hand to their net team and ballpark POC costs please.

sam_netops: ACL example (replace CIDRs/EIP):
```
# Allow outbound to Redwood Private
ALLOW OUT TCP 443 FROM 10.20.0.0/22 TO 203.0.113.64/26
# NAT for single egress IP
NAT 10.20.0.0/22 -> 35.199.55.11
```
Ballpark POC delta: Hosted = pay-per-use. Dedicated reserved = ~$7k-$20k/mo depending on tier. Private + managed static egress = +$800-$2k/mo. Exact quote from Sales Ops.

leo_se: Operational caveat: if they require original client IP for rate limiting, prefer peering or run proxy in their VPC. We'll document header trust boundaries.

eve_infosec: I'll draft the security wording for questionnaire (KMS, audit retention, TLS inspection caveats).

ria_sales: Who can join a brief handoff call tomorrow 9am PT to finalize CIDRs and NAT EIP?

sam_netops: I'll join.

leo_se: I'll join.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: HarvestRx-network-handoff on 2025-06-14 09:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood.example/harvestrx-1788880000

ria_sales: Thanks team, I'll send the invite and attach the ACL + draft security QA. Action: Sam to provide NAT/EIP sizing and route table snippet; Leo to draft X-Forwarded-For guidance; Eve to finalize security blurb.
